 GTA VI Map Leaks As Collector’s Box Sold Early
 By Can Torcu November 12, 2026 
 GTA 6 
 Share 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Bluesky 
 Pinterest 
 Reddit 
 WhatsApp 
 Threads 
 Email 
 Copy Link 
 Earlier this week, we visited the Selfridges store in London to take a closer look at the new GTA VI merchandise. Rockstar Games has prepared a lot of amazing things for GTA fans at the location, as we covered in our full coverage . However, it looks like the surprises are not finished yet! The official Grand Theft Auto VI map from the Collector’s Box has now been spotted on display at another Selfridges store in Manchester.
 A photo shared by @GazzaMontana shows the GTA VI Collector’s Set on display at Selfridges Manchester Exchange Square, with the official map from the Collector’s Box folded up inside the display. Interestingly, this could mean that someone working at the store has already had a chance to see the full map before it reaches customers. Although the map is not fully visible in the photo, some new in-game location names can still be spotted.
 Here are some of the newly spotted location names, as shared by @saukko505 :
 Southwind: A small settlement located on Goose Key.
 Pelican Valley: A location in the Grassrivers.
 ???moreau: A location in the northern part of the map.
 ??anza: Another location in the north.
 The last two names are not completely clear in the photo, so their exact spelling is still uncertain.
 UPDATE: The full map has been leaked by a user on Instagram. According to sources, one Collector’s Box was on sale at the Selfridges Manchester Exchange Square store today and has since been sold. This might be that one. You can view it below:
 These new names give us another look at the different areas players will be able to explore across Leonida. Southwind and Pelican Valley are particularly interesting, as they reveal more about the smaller settlements and natural areas outside Vice City.
 Rockstar Games has yet to share the full Collector’s Box map with the public. However, with the game’s release getting closer, fans may not have to wait much longer to see the entire map for themselves.
